title: Quantum Query Complexity of Persistence Statistics in Graph Zigzags
summary: We study the query complexity of estimating scalar summaries of zigzag bar lifetimes from snapshot-adjacency bits. For graphs $G_1,\ldots,G_m$ on $n$ labeled vertices, let $\ell_b$ be the snapshot lifetime of a degree-one bar $b$ of the intersection zigzag. For a probability generating function $φ(x)=\mathbb{E}[x^R]$, the statistic $F_φ=\sum_bφ(\ell_b/m)$ includes normalized degree-$r$ total persistence and the mean generalized rank over a uniform time window.
